entities.summary: Mikhail Yuryevich Zurabov is a Russian politician. He was the ambassador of Russia to Ukraine (2009–2016) and former Minister of Health and Social Development (in Mikhail Fradkov's first and second cabinets. He held the post of Minister of Health and Social Development from 9 March 2004 to 24 September 2007.
